## Handling Rules

- Treat `restricted-secret-or-private` rows as evidence pointers only; do not paste contents into chat or commit them.
- Regenerate this index after major Codex upgrades, crash recovery, or image-generation work.
- Keep all derived artifacts under `.codex-internal/` and ensure `.git/info/exclude` keeps that folder untracked.
